entry.title: MJX MPC Twister 1.0.1
entry.summary: Turn your MIDI Fighter Twister into a hands-on controller for the MPC Live III. - Turn the 16 knobs to adjust the MPC's Q-Links without switching banks. - Press knobs 1–12 to jump between tracks. Use the bottom row for Add Track, Track Edit, Delete Track confirmation, and Clip Matrix. - The light rings show your Q-Link values, and the light under the selected track's knob follows its color. - Plug or unplug the Twister without opening MIDI settings.
